### 🧟 The horde, rebuilt
- Zombies now share the player's blocky build: block limbs, a cube head, mitten fists and boots — so they stand next to you as the same kind of figure.
- Every variant is dressed: a belt, a badge on the cop, one shoe left on the everyman, bare feet on the runt and the feral, and per-zombie wounds — a gash on the back of the head, a torn cheek, a skull showing through the crown.
- Faces move. Eyes blink and dart in their sockets, the mouth hangs open in its own shape per variant, and the lower jaw drops on the bite and when the zombie groans, chewing idly in between.
- The headscarf-looking hair cap is gone; the horde goes bare-headed.

### 🏃 How they move
- The crawler actually crawls: hands and knees land on the ground and drag the body along, and it rears up on one arm to strike.
- The runner sprints with a real stride — both feet leave the ground, the heel kicks up behind.
- The standing attack is a two-handed slam: both arms rise, hang for a beat, and come down together.
- **The hit lands when the hands do.** Damage now arrives on the blow, not on a hidden timer — step out of reach before the arms come down and you have dodged it.
- Zombies, animals and mutants sit on the slope they stand on instead of floating level across a hill, and zombies climb slower uphill.

### 🚧 Bodies are solid
- You can no longer walk through other players, zombies or animals, and they can no longer walk through you. Bodies push apart instead of sticking together.

### 🎩 Traders
- The traders have proper faces with coloured eyes, hair that hugs the skull, hats worn on the brow line and sturdier limbs.

### 🎬 The sixth test
- Starting a new survival world now opens with a scene: four days after the bite, strapped to a gurney, still talking — and a sister with a plan for the gate.
- It plays once per world. A new game plays it again; continuing one you already started does not.
- Skippable at any point with the on-screen button.

### 🏥 Medical & lab props
- Five new props for the map and structure editors, under a new Medical & Lab category: a hospital gurney, a drip stand, a vitals monitor, a supply trolley and a wall cabinet.
- Shots pass between the gurney's side rails instead of stopping on thin air.

### 👀 Faces that are alive
- Characters in a scene blink, and their jaws move while they speak.
